text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Summer training camp's last day already, huh...
Felt like it went by pretty fast this year.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Still... that felt solid.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Don't blame me if everyone turns you down,
saying there's no point practicing with a squirt like you.
"No one's going to say things like that to you anymore."
"There's no one left who will say that to you."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho... Let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
The person in front of the monitor is—

text_block_list.name: Monitor Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—50 meters remaining, Narita Brian is in the lead!
Narita Brian...
maintains her lead all the way across the finish line!"

text_block_list.name: Monitor Audio
text_block_list.text:
"A staggering 9-length margin over 2nd place!
Narita Brian caps off her debut race
with a spectacular victory!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Brian,
didn't you just make your debut recently?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Taishin.
...Ah, she enters the Junior Class starting this year as well.
(Narita Brian—an Umamusume with devastating athletic ability often hailed as a "Monster," and Biwa Hayahide's younger sister.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"She's so proud of her little sister's success that she keeps watching it over and over...
...Wait, that's not quite it."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...It might have been nice
if we had the kind of relationship where we could think that way.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“The ‘Monster’ has already been unleashed from her cage.
From here... she'll rack up victories at a blistering pace
and storm up the path of glory.”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —The day you come for my throat cannot be far off.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hayahide...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Still, I won't let them tear me down.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ――The completion of the "Winning Formula" is near.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Wh-What? That girl's hindquarters...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (That's way beyond just being 'well-trained'—!!)

Summer training camp came to an end...
and the Kikuka Sho, rife with premonitions of turmoil, was drawing near.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...*cough*, *cough*!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Damn it... I've been coughing a lot lately...
